text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx responses from edge-gateway in us-west1. 5xx rate 12% -> paging on-call. impact: some streaming and generation requests failing. auto-failover not triggered (threshold not met).

alex: acked. on-call and looking. grabbing logs and perf dashboards.

maria: seeing a bump in upstream 502/504 from gateway -> model-proxy. tcp retransmits up ~30% on us-west1 egress.

devon: are we seeing any queue saturations on the edge workers? metric: edge.request_queue_length spikes?

alex: yes, queue length on edge-pool-us-west1 up to 120 (normal 6-8). cpu on edge proxies low, sockets in CLOSE_WAIT climbing.

jae: hitting connection resets to dedicated backend: "connect ECONNRESET" in proxy logs. suspect load balancer health checks or too many idle connections.

paul: quick check: scaling of model-service in us-west1 is healthy (pods 20/20). but connection churn high between gateway->backend. Could be transient network flaps at infra layer.

maria: customer reports: few prod customers seeing timeouts and retries, noticeable for long-running chats. severity P2 for now; we'll escalate if error rate holds >15 min.

alex: immediate plan: (1) throttle new long requests at gateway for us-west1 by lowering concurrency (soft cap), (2) enable cross-region failover for 20% of traffic to us-east as a mitigation canary, (3) increase proxy keepalive timeouts, (4) collect tcpdump and socket stats.

devon: I'll apply a temporary rate-limit rule on the us-west1 gateway route: limit 100 concurrent streams per region and 10rps per org for long-poll endpoints.

jae: enabling the failover route now: traffic shift policy -> add weighting us-east 0.2 for gateway-route-* (will do gradual shift over 30s).

incident-bot: ACTION LOG: devon set rate-limit rule rl-196999; jae updated routing policy r-196999.

maria: after 30s of the shift, 5xx in us-west1 dropped from 12% -> 7%. us-east saw a small uptick but remained <1% absolute. good sign.

paul: socket CLOSE_WAIT still high. I'm going to bump proxy keepalive from 30s -> 90s and restart a narrow subset of edge pods to clear conn state (rolling, 10%).

alex: pls coordinate restarts with jae to avoid overlapping with routing changes.

jae: ack. I'll throttle shift until pods restart complete. doing a rolling restart of edge-proxy-us-west1 (10% batch).

devon: adding temporary circuit breaker to model-proxy upstream: fail after 50 errors in 1m -> short-circuit for 20s to reduce thrash.

maria: tcpdump captured: bursts of RSTs from internal NAT gateway around time X. file saved to s3://logs/incidents/196999_tcpdump.pcap.

paul: open ticket with infra networking to check NAT instance health in us-west1 and to validate route table flaps. tagging networking-oncall.

alex: customer impact blurb for comms: "We saw elevated 5xx rates in our us-west region impacting a subset of real-time generation requests. We routed a portion of traffic to an alternate region and applied mitigations; error rates are returning to normal. We continue to monitor and investigate root cause." any objections?

devon: looks fine. indicate if any customers require dedicated follow-up (we have a couple high-traffic customers).

maria: Monitoring: keep alerts at 5m intervals. If 5xx >10% for 10m, escalate to P1.

incident-bot: NOTE: 3 additional on-call notifications sent to networking-oncall and infra-sre.

jae: rolling restart complete for first batch. connection resets dropped, queue length back to ~15.

paul: keepalive bump applied across proxies. start timeouts and socket churn decreased.

maria: after 8 minutes from action start: us-west1 5xx at 3.2%, us-east 0.9%, overall error budget stable.

alex: next steps: (1) infra team to root cause NAT flaps, (2) leave cross-region weight at 20% for 30m then gradually shift back if stable, (3) add a temporary route fallback for customers flagged as high-sensitivity, (4) schedule post-incident RCA if root cause confirmed.

paul: opened infra ticket INF-196999 assigned to networking team. linking pcap and proxy logs.

devon: I'll roll back the temporary rate limits after 45m if system stable.

jae: leaving routing at 20% for now. set auto-rollback if us-east latency >200ms or error rate >2%.

maria: final status (T+20m): Mitigations successful, partial failover active, customers impacted minimal after shift. creating incident summary and tagging for RCA.

alex: handing incident to infra and networking. I'm done on-call for this page. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigation in place). summary: cross-region canary failover + proxy keepalive/rolling restarts reduced 5xx from 12% -> 3.2%. follow-up: RCA with networking, consider autoset failover threshold lower for future similar symptoms.
